mapper.sql: id, request_id, activity_id, seckill_sku_id, sku_id, user_id, user_address_id, order_no, order_id, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, fail_reason, stock_returned, create_time, update_time, is_deleted
mapper.insert: insert ignore into seckill_order_request ( request_id, activity_id, seckill_sku_id, sku_id, user_id, user_address_id, order_no, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, stock_returned, create_time, update_time, is_deleted ) values ( #{requestId}, #{activityId}, #{seckillSkuId}, #{skuId}, #{userId}, #{userAddressId}, #{orderNo}, #{status}, 0, now(), 0, now(), now(), 0 )
mapper.select: select from seckill_order_request where request_id = #{requestId} and is_deleted = 0
select from seckill_order_request where order_no = #{orderNo} and is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: update seckill_order_request set status = 1, update_time = now() where request_id = #{requestId} and status = 0 and next_retry_time <= now() and is_deleted = 0
update seckill_order_request set status = 2, order_id = #{orderId}, fail_reason = null, update_time = now() where request_id = #{requestId} and status = 1 and is_deleted = 0

update seckill_order_request set status = 0, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, fail_reason = #{failReason}, update_time = now() where request_id = #{requestId} and status = 1 and is_deleted = 0
update seckill_order_request set status = 3, fail_reason = #{failReason}, update_time = now() where request_id = #{requestId} and status in (0, 1) and is_deleted = 0
update seckill_order_request set stock_returned = 1, update_time = now() where request_id = #{requestId} and status = #{expectedStatus} and stock_returned = 0 and is_deleted = 0
update seckill_order_request set status = 4, fail_reason = 'ORDER_CANCELLED', update_time = now() where order_no = #{orderNo} and status = 2 and stock_returned = 0 and is_deleted = 0
update seckill_order_request set status = 0, next_retry_time = now(), update_time = now() where status = 1 and update_time < #{staleBefore} and is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: select from seckill_order_request where status = 0 and next_retry_time <= now() and is_deleted = 0 order by next_retry_time, id limit #{limit}
select from seckill_order_request where status = 3 and stock_returned = 0 and is_deleted = 0 order by update_time, id limit #{limit}

select r.id, r.request_id, r.activity_id, r.seckill_sku_id, r.sku_id, r.user_id, r.user_address_id, r.order_no, r.order_id, r.status, r.retry_count, r.next_retry_time, r.fail_reason, r.stock_returned, r.create_time, r.update_time, r.is_deleted from seckill_order_request r inner join order_info o on o.order_no = r.order_no and o.order_status = -1 and o.is_deleted = 0 inner join inventory_request i on i.order_no = r.order_no and i.status = 3 and i.is_deleted = 0 where r.status in (2, 4) and r.stock_returned = 0 and r.is_deleted = 0 order by r.update_time, r.id limit #{limit}
